validation: Exact-ROM runtime signature, structure and transition checks; see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md. Historical source rebuild is not byte-identical.

campaign_validation.map_layout: live dimensions and warp tuples crosschecked per current map against source priors
campaign_validation.battle: requires coherent battle flag plus both sane combatants and own party correlation; source layout checked at runtime
campaign_validation.terminal: Exact ROM counter-increment signature at ROM offset 0x701eb; completion requires live HALL OF FAME text+map+count+8 badges+party, never counter or map alone
campaign_validation.party_registration: Exact ROM AskName continuation at ROM 0xf362/CPU0x7362 must be on live stack, naming context and new species/count agree, and last structure is all zero. Interactive pending state is distinct from malformed party data.
campaign_validation.move_pp: 165x6 move-data bytes uniquely match ROM0x38000; complete AddBonusPP instructions match ROM0xe673 and Divide wrapper at0x38d0. maxPP=basePP+min(basePP//5,7)*(rawPP>>6). Must match at runtime; unknown otherwise.
campaign_validation.battle_intro: Actual JEV run2 step489: wild battle text box with font flag0 precedes valid own battle mon. Battle flag+box verifies phase only; combatants withheld until valid/correlated.
